description: Phase 7 validation sites. Each is a ~0.007° x 0.005° rectangle (~40 ha) chosen to exercise a different screening rule. Periods: dry season (Oct-Mar) 2021-22 vs 2025-26.

sites.name: Ameenpur urban fringe, Sangareddy, Telangana
sites.purpose: Peri-urban land cover mix; lake 50 m away (wetland buffer rule)

sites.name: Thane Creek edge, Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
sites.purpose: Coastal mangroves and tidal creek (CRZ and mangrove rules)

sites.name: Kalkere, north of Bannerghatta NP, Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka
sites.purpose: Protected area within 10 km (EIA General Condition)

sites.name: North shore of Deepor Beel (Ramsar site), Guwahati, Assam
sites.purpose: Large wetland and seasonal water (wetland and water-share rules, MNDWI)
